title: Mixed scalar/site square for the concrete compact-support coefficient map
statement: Let A and B be finite commutative rings and let phi:A→B make B finite free over A. For noetherian schemes X,Y, a compactification c of f:X→Y, bounded-below etale derived objects L over A and N over B, and gamma:N≅S_X L, the concrete coefficient arrow obeys SiteCompatibility(phi,c,L,N,gamma) [def-pur-finite-free-compact-support-data]. This asserts only the mixed scalar/site square, not invertibility, origins, naturality, composition, or refinement.

proof.text: Instantiate the two ringed-site systems of the mixed pasting theorem with the ordinary etale and proetale sites. Identify inverse-image balancing using the scalar pullback cube, proper right mates using the fixed direct-image counits, and open left mates using open units. These identify the concrete scalarMate, openIso, and the scalar transpose defining coefficientMap true.

Paste proper and open squares, then use naturality of the compact-support site comparison to transport the B-input along gamma. The two gamma occurrences cancel. The equality is in the B-linear derived category; neither scalar restriction nor site pullback is claimed faithful.

theorem finiteFree_site_square
    {A B : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) (hφ : letI := φ.toAlgebra; Module.Finite A B ∧ Module.Free A B)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    {f : X ⟶ Y} (c : Compactification f)
    (L : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)))
    (N : DerivedCategory.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} B)))
    (γ : N.obj ≅ (Sites.scalar false φ X).obj L.obj) :
    SiteCompatibility φ c L N γ
